text: Caroline's mum passed away on Sunday. Funeral is provisionally 3rd of November at St Mark's. Need to send a card before then.
kavya starts at the new firm 14/11, nervous abt it, says the commute is brutal

Hamza got made redundant, third round of cuts at his place in a year. He's putting a brave face on but he's mostly worried about the mortgage and his eldest starting uni next autumn. Check in with him sometime next week, maybe pint? His wife Kavya is going back to work full time from 1st of December to tide them over, which he feels bad about.
Lila and her boyfriend split up over the summer apparently, she only just told me. Living back at her dad's for now.
Ilse retiring end of the month!! 32 years at the council. Leaving do is Friday 28th at the Crown. Chip in for the collection, Ann's organising it.

so Amir's brother Emre has got the promotion he was going for, he's now head of operations, starts the new role early December, Amir is really proud of him, um, and their mum's having her hip done in January
buy milk, bin bags, stamps
Sophie's daughter Camila is starting nursery after half term. Sophie's more anxious about it than Camila is lol
Catalina - first day at the hospital went well. Loves her team. Hates the night shifts.
Remind me to ring Finn on 3 Dec, it's a year since his dad died.
Sadia mentioned her husband's leaving the bank sometime in the new year to go freelance. She's not thrilled about it.

Salma called this evening, long chat. Her and Delroy have called off the wedding, it was meant to be 14 June. She seems relieved more than anything, says they'd been drifting for ages. She's moving into her sister's spare room at the end of the month while she looks for somewhere. I'm helping her move. Should take her out for dinner sometime next week and not bring it up unless she does.
Rebecca's dog Biscuit had to be put to sleep yesterday. She's gutted. Text her tomorrow.
Emil's interview at Ocado is on the 9th. Really nervous, hasn't done one in ten years. Don't forget to text him good luck the night before.
Akira Sato, new manager at work, ex Google, into bouldering and Japanese whisky. Wife is called Krisztina.

Dimitri lost his grandad last week. Funeral's on the 29th in Thessaloniki, he's flying out with his mum on the 27th and staying till early November to help sort the house. Sounded flat on the phone. His grandad basically raised him while his parents worked, so it's hitting hard. Don't forget to ask Dimitri how the funeral went once he's back.
Hugo said he's handing in his notice Monday. Got an offer from a startup. Hasn't told anyone at work yet so keep quiet.
darius promoted to senior!! finally. drinks thurs
Bridget's son Alfie got into Edinburgh for medicine. She's over the moon. Card?
I'm off work 3rd-7th Nov, dentist on the 4th at 9:15.

Hadiza's mum is in hospital again, chest infection. Hadiza's back and forth every day after work and she's exhausted, her brother's no help apparently and her boss is making noises about her hours. She's got the kids, the dog, the lot. Ask if she wants me to have the kids Saturday.

Ciara's partner Noah got laid off on Friday along with half his team. They've got the baby due in February so it's a lot. Ciara said she's holding it together but she sounded rubbish. Noah's already applying for things and has a second interview with a logistics firm sometime next week. Their little boy's birthday is 30th of November too.
Delroy retiring in the spring, wants to walk the Camino with his wife. Ask him about it next time I see him.
Joanna's leaving drinks got cancelled, too many people off sick. Doing a dinner on 22/11 instead. I'm bringing dessert.
Suzanne's brother has just finished training with the fire service, passing out ceremony 12 Dec. Big family do after.
Ana broke up with Hugo. Not surprised tbh. She's going to her parents' in Porto for a couple of weeks over Christmas.

Note for later. Talked to Kavya Patel at the school gate, her husband Darius has a new job in Manchester starting first of February, so they're moving up sometime in the spring, probably over the Easter holidays, and the kids will switch schools in April. She's really sad about leaving, she's been here fifteen years. Their eldest is doing her GCSEs in May so the timing's awful. I should ask if they want a hand with packing nearer the time.
Krisztina got the head of department job! Starts after Easter. Send flowers.
Emre's nan's 90th is Saturday 8 Nov. He's doing the cake. Wants present ideas for her, she likes gardening and crosswords.
need to finish the tax return by end of jan. and renew passport before March
Camila's dad is having bypass surgery on the 17th. She's terrified. Message her that morning.
Rebecca "Becks" Lewis from five a side, just started as an apprentice electrician, loves it. Massive Arsenal fan.
Amir and his wife Ann just had twins!! Born 2nd Oct, two girls. Need to sort a present.
Caroline said her boss is retiring at Christmas and she might go for his job. Fingers crossed.

Sophie told me about her brother's divorce. Messy. The kids are with him at weekends and he's moved back in with their parents for now, which their mum is loving and their dad very much isn't. Sophie's trying to stay out of it but keeps getting dragged into the middle.
Lila's first week at the bakery done. Up at 4 every day but she says it beats the call centre. Her flatmate's cat keeps sleeping in the flour sacks.
Hamza said Mrs Adeyemi next door died over the weekend. He's going to the funeral Thursday. Maybe I should go too?
Ilse: vegetarian, hates coriander. Grandkids in Bristol.
Rebecca asked if I could cover her shift on the 15th, said yes. Her sister's getting married that day.
Joanna got made redundant this morning. Didn't see it coming at all. Two months' notice, last day 19 Dec. Call her at the weekend, don't just text.

Dinner with Emil and Hadiza last night. Emil's finally leaving the agency, last day is the 31st, then two weeks off before he starts at the BBC in mid November. Hadiza's mum is moving in with them over the summer once the extension's done, which Hadiza is a bit stressed about. Their cat Pickle is on a diet. Hadiza has been dropping hints about a proper coffee machine for her birthday in January.
Bridget's husband passed away in the summer. Just found out from Suzanne. Write to her this week.
Noah: new job at Sainsbury's head office going ok. Probation review end of Nov, he's a bit worried about it.
Akira's son is off to uni in Leeds next September for architecture. She's already dreading the empty house.
Called Gran. She's fine, knee's much better. Wants to go to Whitby in the spring.
Suzanne - find out how her employment tribunal went. It was Tuesday.
Delroy's daughter Ciara graduates on 3rd of December. He's flying over from Kingston for it.
car MOT due 14/12. book it sometime next week
Catalina's having a rough time. Her girlfriend moved out last month and work's piling on. Should get her out for a walk this weekend.
Dimitri and Sadia celebrating 10 years married on 6 May, renewing their vows in Crete. We're invited!
Alfie starts his first proper job Monday, junior dev at a bank. His mum says he's barely sleeping.

okay so random catch up with Ann at the station. Her husband's being made redundant, consultation meeting is on the 12th, and she's going back full time at the surgery from January to cover it. Her son Finn's just done his driving test and passed first time. And her mum's still in the care home in Lewes, Ann visits every Sunday. Remind me to drop round that lasagne she liked.
Kavya, no news on the job yet, they said they'd let her know by 30/10.
Hamza's stag is early March, Prague probably. Wedding 14 May. I'm best man so I need to start planning.
Nothing much from the call with Sophie, just chatting about telly. She's hooked on The Traitors and wants to get into cold water swimming.
Ana's grandad's funeral was yesterday. She did a reading. Check how she's doing end of the week.
Gift idea for Caroline: she mentioned wanting a nice leather notebook for the new job.
Ilse's nephew Darius just started at the police academy. She says he's struggling with the fitness side of it.
Rebecca leaving on the 21st, moving to Dubai with her partner for his work. Get everyone to sign a card.

Salma rang about her dad. He's been told the factory's closing in the spring after 40 years, so he's basically being pushed into retirement at 61. Her mum's thrilled, he's devastated. Salma wants to throw him a party anyway, probably late April, and asked me to help with a slideshow. She's also starting her own new job on 6 Jan, team lead at the hospice. Must message her about photos before Christmas.
